messages:
Jordan Park (Sales): Quick handoff for Velora Health (mid-market).
Jordan Park (Sales): Closed yesterday. Key asks: private VPC, EU data residency, Okta SSO, dedicated capacity estimate, and SLA targets for <200ms p95 on short prompts.
Jordan Park (Sales): Trial metrics: ~120k tokens/day steady, but we see 30% daily spikes; embedding calls ~4k/day. Trial ends in 6 weeks — customer signoff may depend on cost predictability.
Jordan Park (Sales): Renewal risk: customer finance put a temporary hiring freeze; if we can't give a predictable committed-cost plan they may delay renewal.
Jordan Park (Sales): Links: onboarding notes + contract stub -> https://drive.redwood/velora/notes (internal). CC: @Priya Kaur @Miguel Santos @Sam Park
Priya Kaur (CS): Thanks — taking point. I'll schedule a kickoff next week. Need: customer admin contact, exact Okta metadata, and preferred maintenance window.
Priya Kaur (CS): Can engineering confirm whether private control plane + on-prem package are required or VPC-only will suffice? @Miguel
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): VPC should be fine but want to validate embedding latency under quantized model. Can we get a sample payload and current tail-latency logs?
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): Also need model: they're currently using open-llama-13b-quant. Any preference to test a 4-bit variant?
Sam Park (Support): Please add primary support contact and severity matrix. Who is the POC for after-hours? We should add them to the on-call rotation temporarily.
Jordan Park (Sales): POC: Claire Mendes (Claire.M@velora.health), mobile +1-415-555-0132. Billing contact: Raj Patel (raj.p@velora.health).
Jordan Park (Sales): Okta metadata: uploaded to drive link above. Maintenance window: weekdays 10pm-2am CET preferred.
Priya Kaur (CS): Action items I'm taking: 1) Kickoff invite + agenda (owners: Priya) 2) Run cost estimate for 3 capacity tiers (owners: Priya + Eng) 3) SSO test with Claire (owners: Priya + CS Enablement) 4) Ops playbook & escalation path (owners: Sam)
Priya Kaur (CS): I'll share a concise playbook template in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): I'll run a quick perf sweep on a dev VPC. Need a sample of their embedding batch (size ~4k/day -> send 1000 random example rows).
Sam Park (Support): Once we have the playbook, I'll set up an incident channel and add Claire and Raj with limited perms. Also recommend 24/7 on-call for first 30 days post-go-live.
Jordan Park (Sales): FYI customer requested an integration with their internal triage system (Jira). They'd like webhook support for errors and usage alerts.
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): Noted. I'll prototype webhook consumer. Minimal snippet they suggested:
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): ```json
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): {"event":"usage_alert","threshold":100000}
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): ```
Priya Kaur (CS): Timeline proposal: Week 0 - kickoff and SSO test; Week 1-2 - VPC provisioning + perf tests; Week 3 - pilot with 2 teams; Week 4 - go/no-go and finalize commitment.
Priya Kaur (CS): If finance still needs cost certainty, we can propose a 6-month reserved capacity trial with a termination window. Will loop in Sales for pricing options.
Sam Park (Support): Please confirm contact for urgent security questions (email + phone). Also any compliance docs (SOC2, DPIA) I should preload.
Jordan Park (Sales): Security POC: Helena Ortiz (sec@velora.health). They asked for SOC2 Type II and a DPIA template — attached in drive.
handoff-bot: Handoff checklist created and assigned to Priya Kaur (CS): https://internal.redwood/handoffs/1763672000
Priya Kaur (CS): Got it, thanks. I'll update this thread after the kickoff and post the playbook and provisional capacity tiers.
Jordan Park (Sales): Appreciate it — flagging as medium renewal risk until we have capacity pricing and pilot results. :warning:
Priya Kaur (CS): Understood. Priya -> monitoring and weekly status updates to Sales until contract signed. :spiral_calendar:
Sam Park (Support): I'll draft the initial incident playbook and ping Claire for on-call details. Expecting first draft by EOD tomorrow.
Miguel Santos (Customer Eng): I'll upload perf sweep results to the drive and link to thread when done.
Priya Kaur (CS): Thanks all — moving to action. Closing the handoff here and will reopen with kickoff notes."
